meta.source: Level names follow the Council of Europe CEFR. Descriptions are short paraphrases written for this app, not official descriptors.

levels.name: Beginner
levels.summary: Understand and use familiar everyday expressions and very basic phrases.

levels.name: Elementary
levels.summary: Communicate in simple, routine tasks on familiar topics.

levels.name: Intermediate
levels.summary: Deal with most everyday situations and describe experiences and plans.

levels.name: Upper-Intermediate
levels.summary: Interact with fluency on a wide range of topics and argue a viewpoint.

levels.name: Advanced
levels.summary: Use language flexibly for social, academic and professional purposes.

levels.name: Proficient
levels.summary: Understand virtually everything and express yourself with precision.
